turns.question: What was the 90th percentile order amount in EUR for all orders placed between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the 90th percentile order amount, so I cannot give that figure for 17 August to 2 October 2026; the closest metrics are Average order value (EUR) (average_order_value_eur), Revenue (EUR) (revenue_eur) and Orders (orders_total), and a Median order value (EUR) metric exists only on the BigQuery warehouse, not here.
